2026_03_PHI_CHI.headline: Chicago’s quarterback uncertainty meets Philadelphia’s defensive pressure test
2026_03_PHI_CHI.paragraph1: Chicago’s quarterback situation is the central variable: Caleb Williams and Tyson Bagent missed Friday practice, leaving Case Keenum to run the first-team offense. Philadelphia can stress that uncertainty with Vic Fangio’s defense, while Saquon Barkley’s return to full practice helps the Eagles keep their offense balanced. The Bears need Ben Johnson’s run game and quick passing answers to protect whichever quarterback starts; Philadelphia must account for Chicago’s rushing threat without surrendering explosive throws.
2026_03_PHI_CHI.model_rationale: Philadelphia’s defensive flexibility and healthier backfield give it multiple ways to control the matchup, while Chicago’s quarterback uncertainty raises the importance of efficient early-down offense.
